_comment: Permission scoping for the unattended nightly agent (nightly_agent.sh) ONLY. Not the interactive-session default -- passed explicitly via --settings, never picked up automatically. Deny takes precedence over allow (verified against current Claude Code docs, 2026-07); a broad deny blocks even a narrower allow. Network denial via Bash patterns is enforced at the tool-invocation level, not the OS level -- stated honestly, not oversold: it stops Claude from directly running curl/wget/etc., but does not sandbox the process. WebFetch/WebSearch are separately denied as whole tools.
